config.craftlatro.title: Craftlatro Settings
config.craftlatro.category.browser.descr: The embedded Chromium browser that runs the game.
config.craftlatro.category.craftlatro.de: How Craftlatro presents Balatro over Minecraft.
config.craftlatro.windowMode.tooltip: Changes apply the next time the Browser window opens.
config.craftlatro.backgroundBlur.tooltip: Whether the background behind the window is blurred.
config.craftlatro.aspectLocked.tooltip: Locks browser window aspect ratio when you resize it. Holding shift during a drag will override this setting.
config.craftlatro.gamePath: You can select your Balatro installation with /craftlatro pick <path to Balatro.exe> or by pressing the keybind (default: F9).
config.craftlatro.openToggle.tooltip: Turn this off if you need the open key to function in the Browser. Otherwise, this shouldn't need to be touched.
config.craftlatro.lovejs: Craftlatro runs in love.js, a port of the LÖVE engine. RNG, visual shaders, and audio may differ. 100% Parity is not guaranteed, but gameplay should be essentially the same.
config.craftlatro.renderScale.tooltip: Percentage scale applied to the browser. Lower is faster, but looks less sharp. Not recommended to change from 100 unless you are struggling with FPS. Applies immediately.
config.craftlatro.frameRate.tooltip: Essentially, the max FPS of the browser. Caps out at Minecraft's FPS.
config.craftlatro.statsOverlay.tooltip: Shows stats for nerds and debugging in the corner of the Browser window.
